name: SLS Playa Mujeres
insider_take: This ultra-modern adults-only sanctuary sits on pristine Playa Mujeres, where powdery white sand meets crystalline Caribbean waters just 10 minutes from Cancun's mainland.
whats_special: SLS Playa Mujeres boasts the signature Philippe Starck design aesthetic that defines the SLS brand, featuring whimsical yet sophisticated interiors. The resort sits on one of Mexico's most exclusive beaches, offering unparalleled privacy with easy access to Cancun's attractions. The property features multiple infinity pools, world-class dining concepts, and direct beach access to some of the Caribbean's clearest waters.
pro_tip: Book a beachfront suite on the north side for stunning sunrise views over Isla Mujeres, and time your stay during whale shark season (June-September) for incredible snorkeling opportunities just offshore.
dont_miss: Take the complimentary ferry to nearby Isla Mujeres to explore Punta Sur's sculpture garden and lighthouse, or venture to the underwater museum MUSA, one of the world's largest underwater art installations, just a short boat ride away. The resort's rooftop bar offers panoramic views of both the Caribbean Sea and Nichupté Lagoon.
pros: Modern luxury design with Philippe Starck aesthetics
Prime beachfront location in exclusive Playa Mujeres
Multiple world-class dining venues and rooftop experiences
All-inclusive luxury with premium brand amenities
cons: Higher price point for luxury positioning
